title: AISU 50ml Shortfill – Cucumber
description:
AISU Cucumber shortfill e-liquid has a fresh and clean flavor; on inhale, a light cucumber flavor develops, bringing with it a floral element that remains sweet. On exhale, this is blended with chilly menthol undertones creating an icy afterbite.
AISU Cucumber has 70%VG / 30%PG for maximum flavour enhancement and dense clouds and comes in a 60ml bottle with space for a nicotine shot.
70% / 30% | VG / PG
